description: A seated figure under a gold parasol on a red-cushioned dais watches as dozens of labourers haul a tall, smooth, unmarked pillar upright with ropes up a brick ramp toward a massive stepped stone fortress with crenellated walls. A river with boats and a distant smoke plume fill the background, and a crowd of onlookers in turbans and long coats stands at the lower left. The painting runs edge to edge in an oil-painting style, with no text or frame visible.
